newsitem.title: UK: Over 44pct of Malaysia Equity wants cash - Peregrine.
newsitem.headline: Over 44pct of Malaysia Equity wants cash - Peregrine.

text.p: Requests for repurchase from shareholders in the $210 million Malaysia Equity Fund show that 44.10 percent of shareholders want a cash exit from the fund, Peregrine Securities (UK) said.
In a statement, Peregrine, which is seeking to oust the incumbent board of the fund and liquidate it, said that a further 33.53 percent of holders wanted repurchases in exchange for stock.

"Under Peregrine's proposals these repurchase requests will be satisfied in full by the board on October 1. Under the board's proposals, shareholders would not receive their full requests for cash until April 1997," Peregrine said.
Peregrine said that the shareholders wanting cash or stock accounted for $163 million of the fund, leaving $47.0 million in the fund..

"These figures clearly demonstrate that, contrary to the spurious claims of the board and their financial advisors, our proposals satisfy the demand of shareholders," said Pergerine corporate finance director, Nicholas.
The fund will go to a final vote on September 24 at a meeting in Hong Kong.
